people.name: Juan Garzón
people.role: Research collaborator · Universidad Católica de Oriente
people.topic: Educational technology, AI literacy & editorial collaboration
people.description: Juan Garzón and Hüseyin Ateş have published together on augmented-reality adoption and flipped-learning readiness. Their current collaboration also includes the Türkiye–Colombia GenAI literacy study and development of an ETHE thematic-collection proposal.
people.detail: The ETHE proposal remains subject to journal approval. Earlier guest-advisory work concerns the separate Sustainable Environment collection Emerging Technologies for Sustainable Development.

people.name: Omid Noroozi
people.role: Research collaborator · Wageningen University & Research, Netherlands
people.topic: Scientific argument revision, feedback & learner control
people.description: Scholarly collaboration on an empirical manuscript examining feedback, scientific argument revision and learner control. The manuscript is being developed with Hüseyin Ateş and MohammadReza Farrokhnia, with conceptual framing and revisions under discussion.
people.detail: The collaborative work focuses on conceptual framing, feedback processes and scientific argument revision. Details of any possible visiting-researcher activity are kept in the separately labelled proposal register.

people.name: MohammadReza Farrokhnia
people.role: Research collaborator · University of Twente, Netherlands
people.topic: AI in education, technology-enhanced learning & feedback
people.description: An ongoing scholarly collaboration with Hüseyin Ateş and Omid Noroozi concerns the conceptual framing and revision of a manuscript on human–AI feedback and scientific argumentation.
people.detail: MohammadReza Farrokhnia confirmed participation as a secondary proposer in the submitted SciEpi-Feedback COST proposal. That contribution is participation in a submitted network proposal, not evidence of an awarded COST Action or funded appointment.

people.name: Kazem Banihashem
people.topic: Human–AI feedback, argument revision & learning analytics
people.description: Scholarly collaboration includes methodological discussion and manuscript review and revision on retrieval-grounded generative AI, adaptive feedback and scientific argumentation.
people.detail: The academic collaboration concerns methodological discussion and manuscript development. Related funding opportunities, if pursued, are not represented as existing research awards.

people.name: Elena Novak
people.role: Research collaborator · Kent State University, United States
people.topic: AI system design, epistemic vigilance & scientific judgement
people.description: Active intellectual collaboration on a developing manuscript examines how features of GenAI-supported learning systems relate to learners’ evaluation of AI-generated claims and their independent judgement. Contributions include critical manuscript reading and conceptual and literature-review development.
people.detail: The ongoing contribution concerns conceptual framing, review of the literature and critical interpretation of a developing manuscript. No published joint output or confirmed institutional visit is asserted.

people.name: Guido Makransky
people.role: Research collaboration discussions · University of Copenhagen, Denmark
people.topic: Immersive science learning & reflective GenAI scaffolding
people.description: Research discussions focus on a manuscript concerning immersive learning and a potential small pilot comparing reflective forms of GenAI support and fading in an immersive science-learning context.
people.detail: The collaboration is at the discussion and study-design stage. No funded project, completed pilot, accepted co-authorship or formal institutional partnership is implied.

people.name: Moritz Krell
people.role: Research collaborator · IPN Leibniz Institute, Germany
people.description: Joint concept development with Hüseyin Ateş focuses on scientific reasoning after AI feedback, particularly distinguishing recognition of evidence origins from using that information in scientific evaluation. Text-based and graphical task prototypes are being refined.
people.detail: A TÜBİTAK–DFG bilateral research route and alternatives involving related national proposals are under discussion. No DFG or TÜBİTAK application or funding award has been confirmed for this concept.

people.name: Georgios Lampropoulos
people.topic: Flipped learning, scientific reasoning & manuscript development
people.description: Georgios Lampropoulos co-authored the published study on science teachers’ flipped-learning readiness with Hüseyin Ateş and Juan Garzón. Their continuing collaboration includes development of a manuscript on evidence-based reasoning before AI-provided answers.
people.detail: Published collaboration is distinguished from manuscript development in progress; no unpublished findings or funded visiting appointment are claimed.

people.name: Naomi Winstone
people.role: Research collaborator / proposed academic host · University of Surrey
people.topic: Feedback processes, evaluative judgement & learner agency
people.description: Professor Naomi Winstone supports the proposed TÜBİTAK 2219 research visit at the University of Surrey as academic host. The submitted project examines scheduled fading of GenAI feedback and independent scientific argumentation. Scholarly collaboration also concerns conceptual framing and interpretation in a separate GenAI manuscript.
people.detail: The formal host invitation supports the application; it is not a TÜBİTAK funding award or confirmation that the visit has begun. The proposed visit period is May 2027–May 2028, subject to the funding decision and relevant institutional arrangements.

people.name: Ahmet Sami Konca
people.role: Research collaborator · United Arab Emirates University
people.description: Collaboration with Hüseyin Ateş includes a published study on scientific agency in preschool STEM and joint development of an AÜB International BAP proposal on GenAI guidance for preservice preschool teachers’ independent STEM instructional design.
people.detail: The international proposal is submitted with a funding decision pending; it is distinct from the published preschool-STEM collaboration.

people.name: Juan David Murillo Egurrola
people.role: Study coordinator · Universidad Católica de Oriente
people.topic: GenAI literacy and responsible academic use
people.description: Juan David Murillo Egurrola coordinates the Türkiye–Colombia AI literacy study, working with Juan Garzón and Hüseyin Ateş on the conceptual model, questionnaire and cross-institutional research preparation.
people.detail: Current collaboration covers instrument refinement, language adaptation, disciplinary-sampling coordination and preparation for cognitive interviews and piloting. A completed international data collection or external grant award is not claimed.

people.name: Marc Romero Carbonell
people.role: Editorial liaison · ETHE / Universitat Oberta de Catalunya
people.topic: Proposed thematic collection on learning with GenAI
people.description: Editorial discussions with Marc Romero Carbonell concern the scope, international guest-editor team and development of a proposed collection for the International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education. Hüseyin Ateş and Juan Garzón are developing the proposal in consultation with him.
people.detail: This is an editorial connection, not an appointment to the same research group or a research co-authorship. The collection still requires journal approval; no open call or final publication timetable is announced.

people.name: Abdulkadir Aydın
people.description: Doctoral research under the principal supervision of Hüseyin Ateş at Kırşehir Ahi Evran University. Abdulkadir also contributes to the Türkiye–Colombia GenAI literacy study through Turkish instrument-adaptation review and programme-level preparation for fieldwork.
people.detail: Expected doctoral completion: 2028. These collaboration activities are distinct from a confirmed dissertation title or a funded-project appointment.

people.name: Tuğçe Ünsal
people.description: Master’s research examines the effect of Zimmerman-based self-regulation support on scenario-based science learning.
people.detail: Principal supervisor: Hüseyin Ateş. Expected completion: mid-2027.

people.name: Nisa Gül
people.description: Master’s research examines science teachers’ intentions to use humanoid robot technology when teaching environmental topics, using the GETAMEL model.
people.detail: Principal supervisor: Hüseyin Ateş. Expected completion: mid-2027.

people.name: Kübra Solmaz
people.description: Completed thesis: Investigation of teachers’ intentions regarding the usability of artificial intelligence-based augmented reality technology in science classes.

people.name: Rabia Ateş
people.description: Completed thesis: Development of a conceptual model for teachers’ intentions to use virtual reality in science teaching.

people.name: Fatma Gazioğlu
people.description: Completed thesis: Examination of teachers’ self-efficacy beliefs toward science education.

people.name: İpek Öz
people.description: Completed thesis: Factors affecting science teachers’ intentions to use distance-education tools: Structural Equation Modelling (SEM).

cv_proposals_page: TÜBİTAK 2219 | Scheduled Fading of GenAI Feedback: Effects on Evaluative Judgement and AI-Unassisted Scientific Argumentation. Applicant; proposed academic host: Prof. Naomi Winstone, University of Surrey. A 12-month visit is proposed for May 2027–May 2028, subject to funding and institutional arrangements.

COST Open Call 2026 | SciEpi-Feedback: Human–AI Feedback for Scientific Reasoning and Epistemic Agency. Main Proposer. Submission confirmed on 27 October 2026; proposed duration 48 months. This is a network proposal, not an awarded COST Action.

ERC Starting Grant 2027 | RECLAIM: When Delegation Changes the Capacity to Judge. Principal Investigator applicant; host institution: Kırşehir Ahi Evran University. Submission confirmed on 10 October 2026; proposed duration 60 months. No funding award is claimed.

Anadolu Universities Union (AÜB) International BAP | Generative AI guidance for preservice preschool teachers’ independent STEM instructional design in Türkiye and the United Arab Emirates. Principal Investigator applicant, developed with Ahmet Sami Konca (UAEU). Submitted; proposed duration 24 months.
Planned applications & proposal development · Not funded

TÜBİTAK 2221 | Visiting-researcher application planning in scientific reasoning, feedback and human–AI learning. Invitations and research agendas are in development for possible 2027 visits; no submitted application, approved visitor or funding award is claimed.

TÜBİTAK 3501 | A renewed application has been submitted for the comparison of a physical humanoid social robot and a screen-based virtual agent in AI-supported self-regulated environmental learning. Submitted · decision pending; no funding award has yet been announced.

TÜBİTAK–DFG / Germany | A joint scientific-reasoning task-validity research concept is under development with Prof. Moritz Krell (IPN Leibniz Institute). Bilateral and separate national funding routes are being considered; no application is submitted or funded.

Türkiye–Colombia GenAI literacy study | Collaboration with Juan Garzón and study coordinator Juan David Murillo Egurrola. Contributions to instrument development, cross-language adaptation and Türkiye-site preparation; pilot preparation is ongoing. This activity is not listed as an external funding award.

International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education (ETHE) | A proposed thematic collection on learning with GenAI, student competencies and educational redesign, developed with Juan Garzón in consultation with Marc Romero Carbonell. Proposal and guest-editor team in development, subject to journal approval; not an open call or confirmed Editorial Board appointment.
Sustainable Environment | Guest-advisory collaboration with Juan Garzón for Emerging Technologies for Sustainable Development. Earlier collection call; no currently open submission window is claimed.

Public summaries: https://huseyinates38.github.io/proposals.html and https://huseyinates38.github.io/editorial.html. Proposed durations and visits are not awarded grant periods or confirmed appointments.
